data.explanation: This is a childcare place offer, not a bill or official notice. You need to decide whether to accept or decline the offered place for Jonas before the deadline shown — the app calculates it from the 12 business days counted from the letter's date. If you do nothing by then, the provider will give the place to the next family on the waiting list, so make sure to reply (by phone or email) in time if you want to keep it.
